title: Artifact for A Session Is Not a Mandate: Safe Continuation for Agent Authorisation Across Policy Revisions
description:
Sanitised provider records, policy inputs, generated results and offline models for the SSR 2026 paper A Session Is Not a Mandate: Safe Continuation for Agent Authorisation Across Policy Revisions. The study examines whether cumulative limits on AI agents survive policy revisions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Apigee and Anthropic Managed Agents. All checks run offline with the Python standard library and need no cloud account. The live capture harnesses are included with their source commits and checksums.
